title: Regulation of Abscisic Acid-Responsive Gene Expression in Plants
summary: This cluster focuses on the regulation of abscisic acid-responsive gene expression in plants. ABF2 regulates this process, while DREB2C affects abscisic acid sensitivity and interacts with ABF2. The relationships between these entities suggest a complex regulatory network involving ABF2 and DREB2C in plant responses to abscisic acid.
